entry_points.text: Prefer early per-CPU node map else warn; fill runtime dump marker bases and always succeed.
Expose kernel, current kernel, optional user and EFI tables as read-only debug entries no-oping when absent, created at init and removed at exit.
Ignore non-maskable, halt on recursion, reject non-kernel selectors except Xen, dispatch, consult bug handler for undefined opcode, else panic and halt.
Sync kernel range at middle granularity; corrupted tables dump and die with kill unless handled; bus faults sanitize, fixup, record and deliver sized or generic error.

exports.text: Map virtual range to KASAN shadow via page-aligned translated bounds; large installers need uniform type, reject populated non-leaves, else install leaf and report status.
Walk kernel and user tables for write-execute verification; user walk silent without no-execute or isolation, kernel walk returns boolean and vacuous success without no-execute.
Query fixup type with none when absent and dispatch across families with fatal paths; classify KMMIO faults as invalid, idle, busy or armed for step.
Translate host virtual to frame for RMP dump; global flag enables unhandled-signal notices by default.

hazards.text: Early alloc bounds memblock and dies with diagnostics when fatal; mixed-type large spans refuse once; firmware window exempted once from write-execute counts.
Unknown and control paths die; early halts on recursion or rejection discarding extended state; middle adoption fatally mismatches; busy tracing and implausible faults only warn.
Lazy flush needs revalidation; unsanitized kernel addresses leak layout; unassigned frames stay blocked by neighbours; overflow must use double-fault stack.
Creation macro instantiates fault trace events; stable facts are legacy warning, fifteen-byte prefetch window and tail-synthesis size and alignment rules.

invariants.text: Normalize shadow to pages, walk top in bounded ranges creating tables, skip present leaves, allocate fresh leaf pages, try aligned large block first releasing on failure.
Derive indices from address, link fresh low page when parent empty, verify against offset view, return child; sync mirrors kernel directory plus bounded low prefix.
Prepare per-CPU offsets, check 32-bit size and alignment stepping by large blocks with wrap guard, instantiate each CPU area, then sync initial table.

Markers order user then kernel regions with names, placeholders, conditionals, sentinel and per-word roots; effective protection intersects user/writable and unions no-execute; flags use fixed columns.
Coalesce consecutive same-level entries with equal protections in a marker, emit interval and size on breaks with elision and check; output to log or sequence with null guard.
Fixups are self-relative with optional result clearing then redirect; bad registers use warned dummy cell; tail synthesis needs exact decode; fault forms preserve trap; restore warns and resets.
Check canonical plausibility for user faults; log unchecked register failures, emulate reads as zero, record I/O error when checked; segment, immediate and length forms share default completion.
Claim KMMIO faults only while active; prefetch filtering covers a narrow legacy envelope, never instruction fetch, checking one bounded window for exact prefix shapes.
Propagate single address at middle level only; alloc faults validate range and accept large leaves; dispatcher tries fixup then prefetch; key test selects error form; wrapper uses zero key.
Probe levels stopping on absent or large; handle errata via rewrite, compat test and delegation; revalidate spurious faults; sanitize kernel addresses; record trap and rate-limit notices.
Require secure paging for RMP lookup combining fine and large reads; validate raw indices; prefer accelerated read else copy fields; dump single assigned frame or scan region for nonzero pairs.

locks.text: Hold non-tracing scheduler read section across KMMIO lookup and arming, releasing on non-arm paths and retaining across step.
Nest global table spin lock outside per-space locks for shared top iteration and per-step propagation; single-address propagation needs caller sync.
Require address-space or VMA read lock, release it, then delegate without locks.

state_machines.text: Select full or split ranges by word size, wire callbacks, walk, then report verdict when checking; wrappers pick user or kernel root.
Search then run at most one handler, unhandled when absent, fatal on unknown or control paths; flexible return converges frames syncing event and selector state before redirect.
Allow one in-flight KMMIO fault: capture page, save step state, notify, arm step masked and present; same-page re-fault stays normal, other-page disarms with log.
Classify oops with hints, cause decode and dumps; kernel path tries stack, firmware, checker and arena before oops; no-semaphore path routes kernel versus user with fixups and forced signals.

structs.text: Dump state holds walker, level, protections, accumulations, run, markers, counts, destinations and accounting; level span is child count times lower span from one page.
Entries pair displacement with packed type, register, immediate and clear flags; touched state spans result slots, saved locations, flags, selectors, origin and event data.
Validate null, limit and readability with distinct alerts, then assemble base and limit from split parts for display.
Raw RMP has paired low/high words; cooked form has guest address, ownership, size and immutability; segment index shifts address, entry index masks frame.
